tw: Kron grills krill on a hill, and a big blue whale pays the bill.
twc: Kron 在山坡上烤磷虾，一头大蓝鲸来买单。

tw: Kron's purple purse has one purpose: to hold a purring cat.
twc: Kron 的紫色钱包只有一个用途：装一只呼噜的猫。

tw: Kron's timetable says it is time to eat a table of lime pies at nine.
twc: Kron 的时间表写着：九点整，吃掉一整桌青柠派。
hint: 按时间表，九点要吃一桌派。

tw: Kron flings a ring, and it rings on the nose of a singing king.
twc: Kron 甩出一个圆环，叮一声套在正唱歌的国王鼻子上。

tw: Normally, Kron's horse eats corn, but this morning it eats a horn.
twc: Kron 的马通常吃玉米，今天早上它吃了一只号角。
hint: 平时吃玉米，今早吃号角。

tw: The cake race will take place on a lake, so Kron bakes on a raft.
twc: 蛋糕比赛在湖上举行，Kron 只好在木筏上烤蛋糕。
hint: 比赛在湖上，烤箱也上筏。

tw: Kron will take part in a dark park dance with a shark in a scarf.
twc: Kron 参加了一场夜里公园的舞会，舞伴是戴围巾的鲨鱼。

tw: Kron is present at roll call, dressed as a present with a red bow.
twc: 点名时 Kron 到了，打扮成一个系红蝴蝶结的礼物。

tw: Kron's two cymbals symbolise his big eyes, until he bangs them on his nose.
twc: Kron 说两片铙钹象征他的大眼睛，直到他把它们拍在鼻子上。
hint: 象征眼睛，结果砸了鼻子。

tw: Kron pitches his tent on a continent of the map, and ten ants move in.
twc: Kron 在地图的一块大洲上搭帐篷，十只蚂蚁搬了进去。
hint: 占了一个洲，被蚂蚁占了帐篷。

tw: President Kron jumps on his desk and presses a dent into it.
twc: Kron 主席跳上办公桌，把桌子压出一个坑。

tw: Kron scores four goals in a toy store, and the store man roars.
twc: Kron 在玩具店里进了四个球，店主气得大吼。

tw: On a stormy morning, a little lamb will be born in Kron's warm barn.
twc: 暴风雨的早上，一只小羊羔要在 Kron 暖和的谷仓里出生。
hint: 风雨再大，羊羔照样出生。

tw: Kron advises a wise old fly to buy a bigger tie.
twc: Kron 建议一只聪明的老苍蝇买条大点的领带。
hint: 苍蝇听劝，领带比它还大。

tw: Athletic Kron runs the path with a bath on his back and lets it drip.
twc: 运动健将 Kron 背着一个浴缸跑小路，水一路往下滴。

tw: Kron, head coach of the hens, coaches them to head the ball, but they head him.
twc: 母鸡队主教练 Kron 教她们头球，她们却拿头顶他。

tw: Kron is respected by the hens, so he inspects their nests with a red pen.
twc: Kron 很受母鸡尊敬，拿着红笔检查她们的窝。
hint: 母鸡都敬他，连窝都给他查。

tw: Hero Kron rows out to rescue a sheep, but the sheep rows him home.
twc: 英雄 Kron 划船去救一只羊，结果是羊把他划回了家。

tw: Kron's power seems to lie in his tie: he pulls it, and five pies fly in.
twc: Kron 的魔力好像在于他的领带：一拉，飞来五个派。

tw: Kron spends ninety per cent of his pennies on one perfect purple pear.
twc: Kron 把九成的零钱都花在一个完美的紫色梨上。
